label: Local axioms 5 and 4 at the selected world give axiom 5 at its successors
description: Frame-theoretic boundary for the actual-world Euclidean premise (F2'), not a route step. Checked: EuclideanAt at w and TransitiveAt at w imply EuclideanAt at every successor of w; reflexivity is not needed. This does not imply global Euclidean access: Control.appendix satisfies both local conditions while failing global Euclideanness at unreachable far. Unverified corollary, not a registered Lean result: local transitivity closes the successor set, so every world reachable from w by a finite forward path is Euclidean. Under both local conditions, global failure can remain only outside that region. Ordinary forward-modal formula truth at w depends only on the generated region when its frame and valuation are fixed; this observation does not cover global world quantifiers or globally stated spine premises. F2' with failure of global F2 alone does not force local axiom 4 to fail. Both local conditions remain OPEN framework commitments.
